text_block_list.text:
On the way back with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, 
who had trained her hardest—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Mrmphh!!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, a lottery. Let's go tell them after 
we finish eating.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp*—Here! It's a lottery ticket, 
Trainer!

Her beaming smile made her intentions 
clear, even without any further 
explanation.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's try drawing once!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

"And hurriedly eating our meat buns... I 
tended to her after she choked midway, 
then lined up for the raffle."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer! I'm going to win the 
grand prize, just watch!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Please make sure to clear your schedule!!

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi enthusiastically turned 
the raffle wheel handle!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wahyaa~~~!?
choice_data_list: Ah, it hit meee?!

text_block_list.text:
We won the grand prize. The shock caused 
both of us to freeze in place.
choice_data_list:
So you can actually win the grand prize in 
the raffle...

text_block_list.text: (Swish swish!)

Even though she had bragged about winning 
the grand prize, she just nodded 
repeatedly in shock. She probably never 
imagined she'd actually hit the jackpot.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um... I won... tickets.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I only blurted that out because I 
didn't think it would happen—!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that's incredible! You're a horse of 
your word!
Yeah, amazing! You really walked the talk!

text_block_list.text:
I check the ticket's destination. If I 
recall, this facility is supposed to be 
quite popular as a recuperation spot for 
Umamusume!
choice_data_list: Awesome! I wanted to bring you along too!

Wonderful! I wanted to bring you along 
too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...! A-Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Ehehehe...! I'm so glad, you look 
so happy...! I'm so glad...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, let's go together, 
just the two of us! To make up for how 
hard you always work, let's drop all work 
completely and spread our wings!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a hot spring... Enjoying 
nature, looking at snowy scenery? Ah, 
cherry blossom season might be nice too!
choice_data_list:
Which period do you want to go to, 
Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm... umm.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: When we both have some time to relax!

And so, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi and I promised 
to go to a hot spring together once things 
settled down.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So closeee! If only you were just one 
place higher!
choice_data_list: It looks super delicious, though!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ! It really is!!
(Grrrumble~...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Me!? Even though I just ate a meat bun!?
choice_data_list: Ahaha, your body's just craving nutrients!

text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's body is maturing even 
further as an Umamusume.

"The fact that more energy than ever 
before is required for that purpose is a 
most welcome development."
choice_data_list: I can really feel your growth.
I can really feel your growth.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm. When you put it that way...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I'm sooo happy! My tummy is 
totally rumbling for it!"
choice_data_list:
Go ahead and gobble up the hamburger steak 
too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

And the prize hamburg steak vanished into 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's stomach as an 
afternoon snack.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oh, ooooh...! Carrots, one, two, three...
choice_data_list: ...We sure got a whole bunch!
...We sure got a whole bunch, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
We had a bumper carrot crop this year! So 
I piled it way higher than usual! Heaped 
it full for you!

Carrots truly worthy of being called a 
"mountain's worth" were packed tightly 
into the cardboard box.
choice_data_list: Now, how to carry this back home...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh. Something like this—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's head home, Trainer!
choice_data_list: W-Wow, that's Uma Musume for you...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...? Indeed I am~ I'm an Umamusume too, 
after all—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Trainer. Did you think I 
wouldn't even be able to carry this 
carrot...?"
choice_data_list:
No, I mean that I should be the one 
carrying it.

No, that's not it, I'm the one who should 
carry it...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh, that one!? Oh, so it's *that* one!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Umamusume, you see. I'm much more 
muscular than you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's heavy lifting or farm work, 
if you ever need a hand with anything, 
please don't hesitate to let me know, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Dependable Tsuyoshi in times of trouble! 
Please write that down in the notebook of 
your heart!

And so began our days of chipping away at 
that massive mountain of carrots together 
with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Aw man! Third prize, huh!
choice_data_list: Well, it's a pretty common outcome.

Well, it's a pretty common outcome, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Neither good nor bad. ...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Agonizing over a bad fortune?! That's 
precisely when you use another fortune to 
overcome it!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wait, Fukukitaru-san!?

The one who appeared was 
Matikanefukukitaru, Tracen Academy's proud 
resident fortune-teller Umamusume.
choice_data_list:
By the way, the lottery isn't 
fortune-telling, you know?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the fact remains that I feel 
uneasy! This is where we should turn to 
fortune-telling!
choice_data_list: Is that so...?
Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mmm—and there it is!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san, you— must use those carrots 
to get healthy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ha, health...! That means—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —So that's what you mean!!

And she created it. A drink made by 
blending carrots... kale, soy milk, apple 
cider vinegar, bitter melon, mekabu 
seaweed, and other ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's make a toast! With 
Tsuyoshi's Special Drink!
choice_data_list: ...Cheers!!

text_block_list.text:
I close my eyes and gulp it down in one 
go. And the taste is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yep, so bitter!!

...Well, it should have made me healthier 
at least.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...*whimper*.
choice_data_list: Days like this happen.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Ahh, but still, to think we 
didn't win anything at all...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
…………Even if you get pocket tissues, it's 
not like they really make you that happy, 
right?

I returned to the academy alongside 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, who had her shoulders 
slumped in dejection...
